name: Skin Spa by Techy Carreno
address: 9644 SW 72nd St, Miami, FL 33173, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Juana Bernilla
reviewSamples.text:
I had a wonderful experience at this spa! From the moment I arrived, the staff was welcoming, professional, and attentive, the place  was clean, peaceful, and beautifully maintained, creating the perfect environment to unwind. The esthetician Maria Teresa took the time to assess my skin and customize the treatment to my needs.
After the facial, my skin felt refreshed, hydrated, and noticeably brighter. I left feeling relaxed and rejuvenated. I highly recommend this spa to anyone looking for excellent skincare treatments and outstanding customer service. I will definitely be coming back!

Juana

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Laureni Medina
reviewSamples.text: I would say for sure this is one of the best places I have ever been. They are not just a spa, they are team of professionals who actually care about you, your skin; they guide you through every treatment and explain you how everything works and the benefits that you will notice. They are excellent professionals. I recommend this place 100%. My face never looks so good as it does now since I started my treatment with them :) Thank u Techy and thank you Carlos!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of lourdes anton
reviewSamples.text:
I had an exceptional experience at this spa in South Miami. From the moment I arrived, the team was warm, attentive, and truly focused on my needs. They took the time to spend with me to listen carefully to all my concerns, especially my swollen ankles and skin that needed extra care.
Carlos tailored my treatment perfectly.
He was outstanding: professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely invested in my well-being. I appreciated how though out the session he shared helpful insights throughout the session, making it not just relaxing but also a learning experience. It is clear that this team brings years of expertise to their work.
BTW, as a nice bonus, the next door vegetarian restaurant is fantastic. The homemade dishes are fresh and flavorful—definitely try the chickpea croquettes with a fresh juice for the ride home.
I am already looking forward to my next appointment to enjoy this wonderful, relaxing experience all over again.
The price at the end of my session was not covered by any insurance policy but, the price was surprisingly low and very affordable for all budgets.
We only have one body. It needs a maintenance plan at my age~~~
Happy I finally found somewhere in South Miami that tailors an individual very reasonably priced plan. Give it a try, the TEA BAR will knock your socks off!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Amanda Sanchez
reviewSamples.text:
I’ve been coming to this spa for years, and I honestly can’t say enough good things about it. Even when I lived out of state, I would plan my visits around coming back here because nothing else compares.

Techy is incredible. She has this calming, nurturing, almost healing energy that you just feel the moment you walk in. I’m really picky about places I go to for massages, facials, or microneedling, and somehow every single visit here meets and goes way beyond my expectations.

If you’re looking for a place where you feel cared for and truly taken care of, this is it. I highly recommend it and appreciate Techy so much for the amazing work she does.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Susana Grossen
reviewSamples.text:
I had been a patient and customer for more than 10 years.. The dedication and attention to detail is outstanding. Their professionalism is not very common in this money oriented industry..
The tea and coffee bar is so inviting.! . the decorations of the rooms are refreshing and beautiful.. Love to be  pampered at  this Spa. congratulations to the owners, Carlos and Tachy for their transparency and achievements, !! 🩷
